the specific rate of xylose utilization is inhibited by ethanol accumulation, but the specific rates of both xylitol production and ethanol production are increased by the accumulation of ethanol.

ethanol is a potent inhibitor of xylose metabolism, but the inhibitory effects are not as pronounced in glucose metabolism.
the effects of ethanol are not limited to the specific rates of ethanol production and substrate utilization.
